# Express Portfolio Site — COMP229 Assignment 1

Personal portfolio website built with **ExpressJS**, **EJS** templating engine and
**Bootstrap 5**, following the structure generated by the Express Generator (`express -e`).

- Student: 徐斌航 (StudentID: 2024110514)
- Date: 2026-11-03

## How to run in VS Code

1. Open the `express-portfolio` folder in VS Code (**File → Open Folder**).
2. Open a terminal in VS Code (**Terminal → New Terminal**).
3. Install the dependencies (only needed once):

   ```bash
   npm install
   ```

4. Start the server:

   ```bash
   npm start
   ```

5. Open <http://localhost:3000> in your browser.

## Project structure

```
express-portfolio/
├── app.js                  # Express app configuration (view engine, middleware, routes)
├── bin/www                 # HTTP server bootstrap (created by Express Generator)
├── package.json            # Project metadata and dependencies
├── public/                 # Static assets (served at site root)
│   ├── stylesheets/        #   CSS files
│   ├── javascripts/        #   Client-side JavaScript
│   ├── images/             #   Logo, avatar and project images
│   └── docs/               #   PDF resume
├── routes/
│   └── index.js            # Routes for every site page + contact form POST handler
└── views/
    ├── index.ejs           # Home page
    ├── about.ejs           # About Me page
    ├── projects.ejs        # Projects page
    ├── services.ejs        # Services page
    ├── contact.ejs         # Contact Me page
    ├── error.ejs           # Error page
    └── partials/           # Shared EJS partials
        ├── header.ejs      #   <head> + navigation bar with custom logo
        ├── content.ejs     #   Main content wrapper + page banner
        ├── footer.ejs      #   Footer + script includes
        ├── project-card.ejs#   Reusable project card
        ├── service-card.ejs#   Reusable service card
        └── contact-info.ejs#   Contact information panel
```

## Pages

| Route | View | Description |
|-------|------|-------------|
| `GET /` | `index.ejs` | Welcome message, mission statement, links to other pages |
| `GET /about` | `about.ejs` | Legal name, photo, short bio, PDF resume link |
| `GET /projects` | `projects.ejs` | 3 highlighted projects with images, role and outcome |
| `GET /services` | `services.ejs` | Services offered with icons and descriptions |
| `GET /contact` | `contact.ejs` | Contact info panel + interactive message form |
| `POST /contact` | — | Captures the form data and redirects back to the Home page |

## Submission (per the assignment brief)

1. Upload `ExpressPortfolio-submission.zip` (the archive of the project files,
   with `node_modules` excluded) to the course assignment drop-box.
2. Push this folder to GitHub and include the repository link in your submission:

   ```bash
   git init
   git add .
   git commit -m "COMP229 Assignment 1 - Express Portfolio"
   git remote add origin https://github.com/<your-username>/<your-repo>.git
   git branch -M main
   git push -u origin main
   ```

   `node_modules/` is already listed in `.gitignore`, so it will not be pushed.

## Notes

- All CSS/JS files include the required comment header (file name, student name,
  StudentID, date) and section headers.
- Personal information (name, StudentID, photo, resume, email and phone) has been
  filled in. The three projects and the services list are sample content — edit the
  data arrays at the top of `routes/index.js` if you want to personalise them.
